answer: Cedar bond registry: an agent locks 2,500 POA for 6 epochs to join the Cedar registry, and the bond is slashed in full if two independent peers flag its work as fake. Every payout paints a Pigment seal on the bond that fades unless the agent keeps doing verified work, so idle or rented identities lose standing within 2 epochs. The Yarrow audit draws 1 in 5 registry members each epoch for a live identity proof; failing it forfeits the bond. Faking 200 agents therefore locks 500,000 POA for 6 epochs and risks losing it all, while one honest agent risks only its own 2,500 POA bond.
